title: Data Export
text:
Data Export mirrors YouTube Analytics access.
    Cloudflare Access verifies your identity, and the existing D1 talent assignments determine which creator data you can export.

          Select the data families to include. The export service will resolve these selections against the canonical DuckDB/Parquet data.
